request.description: On a new idempotency key (`clientMessageId`), the API persists a `messages` row with `role=user` in the same DB transaction as `chat_jobs`, then enqueues the worker. Replays with the same `(conversationId, clientMessageId)` within 24h return the existing `jobId` without inserting another user message. Optional `modelId` pins routing when `plan.featureFlags.modelPicker` is true and the id is listed in `plan.modelAccess` (see migration 037 / admin plans). Otherwise omit `modelId` for auto-selection.

Queued jobs: job marked cancelled and hold released in API. Active jobs: sets cancel_requested + Redis publish chat:cancel:{jobId}; worker aborts stream, releases hold, writes usage, finalises assistant.
202 Accepted — enqueues BullMQ job `summarise` on the chat queue; worker runs deterministic summariser when ≥8 non-summarised messages exist (Module 8).
